summary: Pampa Energía S.A. (Pampa Energy Inc.) filed a Form 6-K on November 2, 2026, disclosing the resignation of Flavia Bevilacqua as an alternate director, effective October 6, 2026, for personal reasons. The Board of Directors accepted the resignation on November 2, 2026, pursuant to Section 259 of Argentina's General Companies Law, noting it was neither fraudulent nor untimely and does not affect the Board's normal functioning. No successor was named. This is a routine governance disclosure, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure, and carries no deal terms. No risk-arb angle applies.
